articles.author: Mario Rodeghiero
articles.description:
I’m excited to share some updates about the Vue Theme for VS Code!  
Over time, this theme has grown thanks to the amazing support from the community — and today it has over 665K installs. It has even made it into the Top 50 themes on the Visual Studio Marketplace!  
Seeing developers from all over the world using it in their daily workflow really motivates me to keep improving it.  

Added support and improvements for:  
🐹 Go

🐍 Python

📘 TypeScript

🐘 PHP

⚙️ YAML







Enhanced UI & syntax highlighting for better readability  



Fine-tuned colors to make the coding experience even more enjoyable  




The goal is to make the theme feel smooth and balanced, no matter what stack you’re working with.  
Even though this theme was inspired by Vue, it also provides amazing support for React and other ecosystems.  
Because sometimes…  
  
I’ll keep working on:  
Expanding language support

Continuous visual improvements

Making sure the theme feels modern and consistent across different frameworks



But here’s where you come in 👇  
This is an open-source project, and your contribution can help make it even better:  
GitHub Repo  
💻 Developers: feel free to contribute directly with PRs

⭐ If you like the theme, consider giving it a star on GitHub

💬 Feedback is always welcome! If there’s a language or syntax support you’d love to see, let me know



The Vue Theme for VS Code continues to grow, not just as a Vue-inspired theme but as a developer-friendly theme for multiple stacks.  
Thanks again for the support, the installs, and the feedback — it truly helps shape the future of this project.  
Stay tuned for more updates, and let’s keep making coding more enjoyable! 
Install the theme on the VS Code Marketplace
articles.title: Vue Theme for VS Code — Now with More Language Support and Improvements
